review.reason: The numbered layout, mapped hazards, tees, greens, walking connectors, and continuous putting surfaces are faithfully represented. The Hole 2 main fairway lacks clearly visible edge-to-edge alternating mowing bands at thumbnail scale.

issues.detail: The broad oval fairway left of the upper-center green reads mostly as uniform turf; its mowing bands are too faint or indistinct to read clearly across the fairway.
issues.consequence: Viewers may not readily distinguish Hole 2's short-cut fairway from the surrounding rough in the overview.
